title: Root canal on an upper central incisor

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Number eight has been dark for a while and the cold test is negative, the nerve is dead.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Starting the root canal on eight, lingual access.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Canal cleaned and shaped, filled with gutta percha. Root canal on eight is complete.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Placing a composite in the lingual access.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Eight will need a crown in the next few weeks since it's discolored and brittle now.
